holdout_protocol.rule: Records before the fixed cutoff are development; records at or after it are prospective holdout. The cutoff never rolls forward.
holdout_protocol.date_only_source_rule: For NBA team-game-log rows without an exact tip timestamp, use the earliest possible tip time at local midnight America/New_York for cutoff classification; a game date that could include pre-cutoff games is conservatively kept in development.
holdout_protocol.market_sample_unit: one verified settled record per unique ESPN fixture ID

walk_forward.method: expanding chronological forecasts; every game uses only strictly earlier completed games; prospective holdout begins at the fixed cutoff
walk_forward.baseline: mean NBA game total over the preceding 90 days (or all prior games when unavailable)

model_calibration.selection_rule: frozen v5.1 production calibration selected on the pre-registered training window; applied identically to live forecasts and holdout evaluation
